Title: Vinod's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Vinod - 35 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Sunita - 31 years, daughter
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Pallavi - 61 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
4. Vikram - 65 years, father
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
5. Sonali - 29 years, friend
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line

Scene 1: The terrace - Day

[Sunita stands on the terrace. Vinod, Pallavi and Vikram stand near her.]

Pallavi: "Let's do something fun today."

[Sunita hangs the wet clothes on the line.]

Vikram (gently): "That's great!"

[Vinod falls from the roof and dies.]

Vikram: "We will never forget you."
